storylines.label: Reinforcement Learning
storylines.latest_title: Alibaba Qwen Introduces QwenGyre: Elastic Reinforcement Learning RL for XLong-Horizon Agents

prior_narrative.tldr: Reinforcement Learning is a loose grouping of RL developments, not one developing story. Since Sep 22 it has collected a multi-agent training paper, Google Cloud and AWS production-scaling guides, and a privacy-constrained RL paper.
prior_narrative.whats_new: Alibaba Qwen introduced QwenGyre on Oct 12, an elastic reinforcement-learning approach for extra-long-horizon agents; the item is a MarkTechPost summary, not a primary release.
prior_narrative.why_it_matters: Teams running RL post-training have AWS and Google reference architectures plus a new long-horizon agent approach from Qwen to evaluate; the encrypted-training work remains research, not a production recipe.

beats.headline: MAGIC learns task-specific multi-agent collaboration graphs with dense-reward RL
beats.summary: Targets the cost/performance tradeoff of fixed agent-team topologies by constructing task-specific collaboration structure incrementally instead of reusing one fixed graph.

beats.headline: Google Cloud publishes a best-practices guide for customizing Gemini via RL
beats.summary: Addresses the gap external customers face when they lack cluster-scale compute or model-internals access for proprietary models like Gemini.

beats.headline: AWS cuts MoE RL training overhead for 40% more throughput on EKS
beats.summary: A reference architecture combining Amazon EKS, EFA, and S3 to scale mixture-of-experts reinforcement-learning training.

beats.headline: Homomorphic Advantage Operator targets RL stability under fully homomorphic encryption
beats.summary: Aimed at cloud deployments where training data must stay encrypted.

beats.headline: Alibaba Qwen introduces QwenGyre for elastic RL on extra-long-horizon agents
beats.summary: Reported via MarkTechPost; targets agent tasks that run far longer than standard RL rollouts.

open_questions: Does MAGIC's learned collaboration topology hold up on agent teams larger than its evaluated benchmarks?
Does Google's Gemini RL customization guide extend to models outside the Gemini family, or is it Gemini-specific tooling?
Does the AWS EKS/EFA/DeepEP throughput gain hold for MoE models smaller or larger than the benchmarked configuration?
Does the Homomorphic Advantage Operator stay stable at realistic model sizes, or only on the small benchmarks in the paper?
Does Qwen publish QwenGyre weights, code, or benchmarks that show the elastic RL gain on long-horizon agent tasks?
prior_narrative.take_for_builders: Scaling MoE RL training? Start from the AWS EKS/EFA/DeepEP and Google Gemini RL guides. Wait for Qwen's primary QwenGyre release before planning around it, and treat the encrypted-data RL paper as research.

day_captions.95f314d9972fcd38: AWS reference architecture scaling MoE reinforcement learning on EKS with EFA and DeepEP for 40% more training throughput.
day_captions.c805ac88165186b6: Arxiv paper on stabilizing RL advantage estimates under fully homomorphic encryption constraints.
